_comment: OPT-IN, DISABLED BY DEFAULT. Codex is NOT a native Seraphim layer — it is an
optional external second opinion. To enable it deliberately, copy the
'mcpServers' block below into a project-root '.mcp.json' (or into
.claude/settings.json under 'mcpServers'), fill in a real command, and
provide OPENAI_API_KEY in the environment. Leaving this file here keeps it
inert: Claude Code does not load '.claude/mcp/*.json'.
